servers.sheet.s3EndpointMoveHelp: Did the server move? Type its new endpoint. Every bucket under this key comes along with its favourites and open tabs, and the saved secret access key comes too.
servers.sheet.addressMoveHelp: Did the server move? Type its new address. Its favourites, open tabs, and saved password come along.
servers.sheet.smbAddressMoveHelp: Did the server move? Type its new address. Its shares and saved password come along, and each share’s favourites and open tabs follow once that share opens at the new address.
